rule: basisPct = (issuerQuoteMid / pythPrice - 1) * 100, where issuerQuoteMid is (bid + ask) / 2 from the issuer's own list (xStocks quotes in cents, divided by 100; PreStocks quotes in dollars) and pythPrice is the latest value of the Pyth feed named in xstock.feedId, read from its push-oracle account on Solana.
referenceOnly: equity and redemptionRate feed ids are published as reference. Only the xstock comparison (same asset, two sources) becomes a basis percentage.
